reviews.title: THIS APP WILL STEAL YOUR MONEY ON FREE TRIAL!
reviews.text: THIS IS A SCAM SITE  Been using this normal free app for awhile and started cycling everyday so weather here in Colorado can change from hour to hour so i decided to try “Weather Live” expanded version and after a couple of day decided it wasn’t worth $29.99 for a yearly subscription. Well when I looked over my credit card statement there was a $29.99 Charge to my card! I immediately wrote to “Weather Live “ and received a response that they want photo shots of when I subscribed and when cancelled .  Funny thing is you can’t get a phot or any data or a photo  they want on the day you started the free trial and with them keeping this information you need to cancel you are screwed ! THIS IS A SCAM SITE !

reviews.title: Notch problem
reviews.text:
First time I’ve deleted it since I downloaded it over 5 years ago.
The hourly update I wasn’t too keen on, we don’t need that. Unless you could enable/disable it or hold for a detailed look, I would’ve been ok with.
It’s the same issue with the rain also, minute by minute updates. But what did it for me was the rain forecast took over the notch & would not go away (tried closing the app, opening other media & playing in background) nothing would disable it. 
Maybe I didn’t look hard enough but I couldn’t find the setting to disable it. 
It’s a great app, so please revert the changes or implement the above.

reviews.title: Not Accurate in Portugal
reviews.text: I’ve been relying on this app, with paid version, for years, and I am now in Portugal. Today, I knew it was much hotter than the app indicated so changed to another app, and there was a 12°F difference! Luckily, on my hike, I was alerted to the more intense heat, before I set off. Other weather forecasts also indicated high temperatures, with heat warnings, for today. I’m disappointed as it’s supposed to be a live weather app. I checked to see if the app and my iPhone needed updating, but both are up-to-date. What went wrong, to create such a huge temperature inaccuracy? It is now evening time, and the app still shows 68°F which is still a huge inaccurate reading, compared to the other apps of 80° F.
